name: Atul Auto Ltd
tagline: Gujarat-based three-wheeler (ICE + slow EV pivot) manufacturer with a sharp recent profit surge (Q1 FY27 PAT +290%) off a low base, but weak capital efficiency (ROCE ~11.3%, ROE ~9.3%), a full ~26x P/E, and an EV segment where it trails Bajaj (~36% EV-3W share) and M&M (~37.6% share) by a wide margin.
business_overview: Atul Auto manufactures three-wheelers (goods and passenger segments) in petrol, diesel, LPG and electric variants, plus spare parts. Recent quarters show a strong volume/profit recovery, but the EV pivot - the segment's structural growth driver - is lagging larger competitors.
fundamentals_table: Q1 FY27 revenue +43% YoY, PAT +290% YoY (off a weak prior-year base); June 2026 monthly sales +34.6% YoY
fundamentals_narrative: Atul Auto's headline growth numbers (Q1 FY27 revenue +43%, PAT +290%) look dramatic but are largely a low-base recovery in the ICE three-wheeler business, not evidence of a structural re-rating. The company's own EV three-wheeler sales are growing only in low single digits while Bajaj Auto (~36% share) and Mahindra & Mahindra (~37.6% share) have already captured the bulk of the fast-growing electric-3W segment - the part of the market with genuine long-term tailwind. Capital efficiency remains modest (ROCE ~11.3%, ROE ~9.3%) and at least one analyst source flags a high debt-to-EBITDA ratio alongside 'management efficiency' concerns even as operating profit grows. The stock's ~26x P/E is not cheap for these return metrics. Notably, the state.json seed note for this stock describes an 'exit call view' from the X source, not a bullish one - consistent with a cautious read here.
technical_read: Trading mid-range of its Rs 380-597 52-week band; not the basis for this call.
